app.name: Libellus

signIn.intro: We'll email you a six-digit code. No password.

account.name: Name
account.nameHint: Home greets you by it. Leave it empty for no name.

error.rate_limited: Too many changes at once. Try again in a moment.

profile.title: Profile

days.title: Reading days
days.label: Read on {read} of the last {count} days

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account?
deleteAccount.text: This permanently deletes your Library, reading sessions, ratings, reviews, collections, your name and your sign-in. It can't be undone.
deleteAccount.unsynced: The change that has not synced yet is lost too. | The {count} changes that have not synced yet are lost too.
deleteAccount.failed: Your account could not be deleted, and nothing was removed. Try again.

empty.title: Your reading gathers here
empty.text: Finish a book and it shows up here: its year, its month, its stars.

profile.loadError: Your reading could not be loaded.
profile.offline: You're offline. Your reading shows once you're back.

home.empty: Find the book on your nightstand, or the one you want to read next.
home.readingEmpty: Nothing in progress. Start something from Want to read, or search for a book.
home.loadError: Your books could not be loaded.

installHint.title: Keep Libellus on your Home Screen
installHint.text: Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. It opens like an app, full screen.

library.title: Library
library.empty: The books you add live here: what you want to read, what you are reading, what you have read.

want_to_read.title: Nothing to read next
want_to_read.text: Books you want to read gather here, newest first.

reading.title: Nothing on the nightstand
reading.text: The books you are reading now will be here.

finished.title: No finished books yet
finished.text: Every book you finish lands here, with its date and rating.

notFinishedEmpty.title: Nothing set aside
notFinishedEmpty.text: Books you didn't finish are kept here, so you can pick them up again.

library.loadError: Your Library didn't load. Check your connection and try again.

error.already_in_library: This book is already in your Library.
error.edition_in_library: That edition is already in your Library as another book.
error.book_invalid: This book can't be added: it is missing what we need to keep it.
error.session_invalid: Those dates, that rating or review don't go with that status.
error.not_signed_in: Sign in again to add books.

error.entry_not_found: This book isn't in your Library any more.

error.ended_before_started: That is before you started it. Pick the start day or later.

search.title: Search
search.empty: Find a book by its title, author or ISBN.
search.noResultsHint: Check the spelling, or search the ISBN of the edition you hold. Or add it by hand; books you add yourself stay private.
search.failed: Check your connection and try again.
search.hint: Not the edition you hold? Search its ISBN.
search.offlineNote: You're offline, so only your Library is searched.

scan.title: Scan a barcode
scan.hint: Hold the barcode on the back of the book inside the frame.
scan.notBook: That doesn't look like a book's barcode.
scan.asking: Libellus uses the camera only to read a barcode. Nothing is recorded or sent.
scan.denied: Allow the camera for Libellus in your browser's site settings to scan a barcode. You can always search by title or ISBN.
scan.none: Libellus found no camera it can use, or could not load its barcode reader. Search by title or ISBN instead.
scan.offline: You're offline. Only your Library can be searched.
